prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing; bounded color-treatment correction of ONE flat opaque 16:9 landscape poster. Input image 1 is the inspected own poster to edit. Input image 2 is its own planning guide, for copy-group relationship and Korean letter anatomy only; never render its gray diagrams.

Observed defect to correct: all three photographs in image 1 retain green foliage, tan skin and brown pots/soil instead of the assigned monochrome with restrained blue shadow separation. Change the photographic COLOR TREATMENT ONLY to crisp black-and-white editorial photography with deep stable near-black values, neutral white highlights, controlled gray midtones and a subtle desaturated ink-blue separation in darker photographic shadows. Remove natural green, yellow, orange, brown and flesh hues completely. Keep rich visible roots, soil particles, skin and pot texture; retain fine details and plausible contact, without adding grain to text or blank reading fields.

Protect the existing functioning poster: same plant and hands; rootball supported in top and middle; plant seated with hands gripping the pot below; exact photographic content and rectangular alternating unequal crops; date-led upper-left visit cluster; middle-right slogan and entire three-line explanation with access/care immediately below; lower-left Korean/Latin identity, invitation and URL together. Preserve ALL twelve printed copy entries exactly once, every Korean glyph and meaningful word space, Latin letters, numerals, periods, en dashes, hours colons, middle dots, ampersand and URL slash. Preserve precise upright mature medium-weight sans letter anatomy, counters, font scale, baseline, line groups and comfortable readability at 720-wide usage. Keep warm off-white reading openings and dark clean type. Do not rewrite, omit, duplicate or add text. No other print, logo, QR, watermark, care labels, package text or internal metadata. No mockup, sheet, frame, comparison panels or extra poster.

The action sequence and its alternating image edges determine the whole composition. Keep substantial image-led repotting content, rather than a passive solid/near-solid/split-field headline/date/info template with small subordinate imagery. No clay/toy/complementary package or big-object/big-title/tiny-footer layout. Preserve full explanation and natural visit-to-care-to-invitation route. One flat opaque landscape 16:9 finished poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.
